entities.name: Kzzy'n
entities.description: Dragon Lord, a warrior of Shandalar who took command of the Red Guild until its downfall.

entities.name: Red Guild
entities.description: Guild of Shandalar commanded by Kzzy'n, with sorcerers, troll shamans, goblin lords and dragons.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Plane where Kzzy'n was a guildlord.

entities.name: Arzakon
entities.description: Evil planeswalker who corrupted the guildlords posing as a benevolent advisor and was banned from Shandalar.

entities.name: Guardian of Shandalar
entities.description: Protector of Shandalar betrayed by the guildlords during Arzakon's War.

entities.name: Arzakon's War
entities.description: War during which the guildlords betrayed the Guardian of Shandalar to open the path for Arzakon.

entities.name: Guildlords
entities.description: Leaders of the guilds of Shandalar, including Kzzy'n, corrupted by Arzakon.

events.summary: The guildlords, corrupted by Arzakon, betrayed the Guardian of Shandalar during Arzakon's War.
events.quote: Together, they betrayed the Guardian of Shandalar during Arzakon's War

events.summary: The Guildlords including Kzzy'n were defeated and Arzakon was banned from the plane.
events.quote: Arzakon was banned from entering the plane.

relations.note: He took command of the Red Guild.
